extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators, co-investigators, and institutional grants/administrative staff preparing NIH-style grant applications (PAR-18-335) and completing facilities, biosketch, and budget sections
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required content for Facilities & Other Resources, Core Facilities descriptions, Clinical Infrastructure, Biographical Sketch (biosketch) format, and Research & Related budget forms for an NIH-style grant application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Molecular biology laboratory capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Support the performance of nucleic acid and protein extraction, cloning, PCR, real time qPCR, Southern/Northern/Western hybridization techniques, SDS and 2D-SDS-PAGE, constructions of RNA libraries for RNAseq analyses and gene knockdown using short hairpin interference RNA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List specific techniques and the equipment that supports them (e.g., thermocyclers, electrophoresis, gel documentation, sequencing/library prep capacity) to demonstrate capacity to carry out proposed molecular work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immunology and cell biology capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Capacity to evaluate immune response at local, systemic and cellular levels using cytometric analysis, phenotypic and functional markers, products of leukocytes, real time PCR of gene products and transcription factors, and ex vivo analysis of inflammatory and immune response cells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document available equipment (e.g., refrigerated tabletop centrifuges, inverted and light microscopes, ELISA plate readers/printers, magnetic cell separators), dedicated cell culture space (biosafety hoods with multiple workspaces, CO2 incubators), imaging (dark room for immunofluorescence with Nikon imaging software), and analysis software (FlowJo).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biostatistics and epidemiology support
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborates in planning, execution and analysis of research studies to ensure valid traceable data and quantitative analysis, including sample size calculations, sampling methods, statistical analysis, and preparation of reports and publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include data management responsibilities (development of databases and custom entry screens, double data entry and interactive checks) and list available software (STATA, Microsoft Office, Epi Info, R, SQLServer).

rubrics_metrics.name: Microbiology and pathogen characterization capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Infrastructure to type and phenotypically characterize clinically-relevant microbial pathogens using conventional culture methods and PCR-based techniques, plus molecular epidemiology methods (PFGE, PCR, MLST).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State capacity for diagnosing/monitoring nosocomial infection patterns, host-pathogen interaction studies, and availability of BSL-3 infrastructure (negative-pressure room and biosafety hood) for pathogens such as M. tuberculosis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vector biology and entomology infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Physical infrastructure including insect colonies with independent colonization spaces and experimental infection areas equipped with physical barriers (BSL 2+), plus entomological equipment (capture traps, microscopes, stereoscopes), microinjection/dissection tools, molecular assays, insect cell cultures, and small mammal trapping capability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe containment measures to prevent escape, experimental infection areas, and computational capacity for statistical and geospatial analyses to identify risk variables for vector control strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — Culture Facilities (Biosafety level II & III)
rubrics_metrics.description: Laboratories dedicated to aseptic culture of cells and microbial pathogens with biosecurity level II and III facilities; equipment includes standard/CO2/low-temperature incubators, light and inverted microscopes, and laminar flow biosafety hoods with gas outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate controlled-access arrangements for high-risk organisms (e.g., MDR M. tuberculosis, dengue, HIV) and list containment and equipment that ensure safe culture work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — PCR / qPCR facility and contamination control
rubrics_metrics.description: Facility equipped with multiple conventional PCR thermocyclers (temperature gradients, 96-well and independent block runs), a Real Time thermocycler (CFX96 BioRad) with analytical software for gene expression and Precision Melt Analyses, Nanodrop spectrophotometer, BioAnalyzer-Agilent 2100, GelDoc imaging system, and designated/segregated areas for different steps of molecular amplification to avoid carryover and contamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document equipment, analytical software, sample quantification/quality tools, and the physical segregation of pre- and post-amplification areas to demonstrate good laboratory practice for molecular assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — Flow Cytometry facility
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipped with a Becton Dickinson Accuri C6 Flow Cytometer and FlowJo, Summit and other specialized analysis software tools; temperature-controlled facility to guarantee optimal equipment function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List flow cytometer models, analysis software, and environmental controls that support reproducible cytometric analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — Cold room and sample temperature monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Area designated to contain ultrafreezing equipment (-80°C, -45°C and -20°C freezers) with central temperature control and monitoring system for all equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize continuous monitoring and centralized alarms/controls to protect sample integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — Biobank management and capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Biobank holding large collections of isolates and biological samples (counts and organism lists provided), equipped with Liquid Nitrogen Storage Vessels and ultrafreezers; management of biological material supported by Biobanco CIDEIM® software according to ethical and legal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe number/types of samples, storage capacities, inventory systems/software, and ethical/legal compliance for sample banking and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core — Autoclaving and waste processing
rubrics_metrics.description: Area for washing, sterilizing, packaging and disposal with autoclaves, balances, glassware washing/drying facilities, and supplies for reagent and media preparation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document sterilization capacity, autoclave sizes/number, and procedures for decontamination and waste disposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Unit roles and responsibilities (CIDEIM-Cali)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical Unit team members participate in design of research documents (CRFs, SOPs, informed consent), manage patient records and clinical research documentation, guarantee ethical conduct, enrollment, treatment and follow-up activities; diagnostic lab processes samples and performs tests for syphilis, HIV and leishmaniasis and can train/advice other labs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail clinical staffing, roles, training capacity, diagnostic capabilities, and adherence to GCLP and ethical standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remote clinical site infrastructure and GCP/GCLP compliance (CIDEIM-Tumaco)
rubrics_metrics.description: Local clinical and laboratory facility in an endemic area equipped for primary care level 1 diagnostic procedures and research sample collection, independent power generator for backup, electronic medical records and e-CRFs designed according to GCP standards and national regulations, regular supervisory visits for monitoring and improvement according to good practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe continuity measures (backup power), data capture systems (e-CRFs/GCP compliance), sample shipping logistics, and supervisory monitoring arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to external technology network and specialized equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Access through collaborators to confocal microscopy (Zeiss LSM 700 with 3D reconstruction, co-localization, marker quantitation), Luminex system for multiplex analysis, and an experimental animal breeding facility with specified animal capacities and surgical/sample procedure labs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List partner institutions, specific instruments available, training/staff availability, and any restrictions on access for project use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library and documentation resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Computerized bibliographic information system, user guidance for bibliographic searches/reviews, lending services, electronic bibliographic consulting, and an online database (SCCOT); access to partner university library resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State available literature access, search support, and any institutional subscriptions that support research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer and network resources
rubrics_metrics.description: 180-node star-format network controlled by a Windows Server 2016 Standard, 90 user computers (with Microsoft Office and browsers), printers and photocopier, dedicated internet service, domain server, and volume licensing for Microsoft Office 365.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document compute capacity, network architecture, software licensing, remote access capabilities, and IT support available to users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document management and collaboration systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementation of SharePoint Online for collaborative web-based sharing of SOPs, Quality System Management documents, and internal communications; OneDrive for file hosting, creation/editing/sharing and remote access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how document control, versioning, SOP dissemination, and collaborative workflows are managed to support quality systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Videoconferencing and remote communication resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Three conference rooms equipped for videoconferencing (projector, audio system, dedicated desktop, 42” LCD displays), use of ZOOM for web-based courses and international collaboration, dedicated laptop for videoconferencing, archiving session recordings to a private YouTube channel, and access to partner institution conferencing facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document AV equipment, platforms used, recording/archiving practices, and how these enable remote training and collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch format and content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors; follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES. Required sections include Name, eRA Commons user name, Position Title, Education/Training (institution, degree, dates), A. Personal Statement, B. Positions and Honors, C. Contribution to Science, D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance (Ongoing Research Support).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the specified section headings and page limit; attach biographical sketch file and current & pending support files as indicated. Include project role, degree type/year, and tracking/funding opportunity identifiers where requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch attachments and identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Biographical Sketch file and Attach Current & Pending Support file; include eRA Commons user name, project role (e.g., PD/PI), degree type/year, and tracking number and funding opportunity number on forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure attachments are named/attached correctly and that identifiers (tracking number, FOA number) are included on forms to link personnel to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample handling and biobank ethical/legal compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Samples collected, processed, stored and shipped according to GCLP guidelines; biobank management supported by software and operated according to ethical and legal guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document SOPs for sample handling, chain-of-custody, informed consent linked to sample storage/use, and legal/ethical approvals for biobanking and sample sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infrastructure reliability and sample integrity measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilities include environmental controls and redundancy (temperature-controlled rooms, central temperature monitoring systems, independent power generator) to assure equipment functioning and protect samples during power outages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe monitoring systems, backup power sources, maintenance/validation schedules, and contingency plans for protecting equipment and samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget form completion requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide organizational DUNS, select Budget Type (Project or Subaward/Consortium), enter Budget Period start and end dates, list Senior/Key Persons with names, project roles, base salary, calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary and fringe benefits; list Other Personnel categories with months and requested salary, and compute Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete sections A & B for Senior/Key Person and Other Personnel with accurate months and salary calculations; include additional senior key persons and attach supplementary files where indicated.
